get.description: Download or stream a file. Range requests and If-None-Match are supported. Authorized by a bearer token or a signed URL.

head.description: Download or stream a file. Range requests and If-None-Match are supported. Authorized by a bearer token or a signed URL.

post.description: Prepares a ZIP of the given files and folders and returns a signed URL that streams it.

get.description: state: queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled.
sort: name, modified, size or type. kind: folder or file.

post.description: tus creation. Headers: Tus-Resumable, Upload-Length, Upload-Metadata with parentId, name, and optionally modifiedAt (Unix milliseconds), sha256 (hex), onConflict (fail, rename, replace).

patch.description: tus append. Body: application/offset+octet-stream; headers Upload-Offset, Content-Length and optionally Upload-Checksum (sha1 or sha256).
